title: Grammar: Reporting Verbs — Patterns and Structures
grammarTip:
Глаголы сообщения (Reporting verbs) — точнее чем просто "said":

CLAIM (утверждать): "She claimed to have finished." (спорное утверждение)
ADMIT (признавать): "He admitted making a mistake."
DENY (отрицать): "She denied stealing the report."
WARN (предупреждать): "They warned us not to park there."
SUGGEST (предлагать): "He suggested changing the deadline."
ACCUSE (обвинять): "She accused him of lying."
APOLOGISE (извиняться): "He apologised for being late."
INSIST (настаивать): "She insisted on paying."

💡 Шаблоны:
claim/admit/deny/suggest + -ing
warn/advise/remind + object + to
accuse + of + -ing
apologise + for + -ing

grammarTable.subject: verb + -ing
grammarTable.verb: admit, deny, suggest, recommend, avoid, consider
grammarTable.example: "She admitted taking the wrong file." "He suggested working from home."

grammarTable.subject: verb + to-inf
grammarTable.verb: agree, offer, promise, refuse, threaten, claim, decide
grammarTable.example: "She agreed to start immediately." "He refused to sign the contract."

grammarTable.subject: verb + obj + to-inf
grammarTable.verb: advise, encourage, persuade, remind, warn, invite, ask, tell
grammarTable.example: "She advised him to apply." "He warned her not to accept the first offer."

grammarTable.subject: verb + that-clause
grammarTable.verb: admit, claim, deny, explain, insist, say, suggest, warn
grammarTable.example: "She insisted that the contract was unfair." "He claimed that he had no prior knowledge."

grammarTable.subject: verb + obj + that
grammarTable.verb: tell, remind, warn, convince, persuade, inform
grammarTable.example: "She told him that the position had been filled." "He convinced her that it was worth applying."

grammarTable.subject: verb + preposition + -ing
grammarTable.verb: apologise for, insist on, object to, accuse of
grammarTable.example: "She apologised for arriving late." "He insisted on reviewing the contract."

rows.example: "She admitted making the error." (acknowledge a negative act)
"He denied taking any credit for her work." (say you did NOT do it)
"The manager suggested meeting on Friday." (put forward an idea)
"She recommended applying for the grant." (say this is a good idea)
"She considered leaving the company." (think about doing it)
"He agreed to extend the deadline." (say yes to doing something)
"She refused to sign without legal advice." (say no to doing something)
"He promised to submit the report by Friday." (commit to doing it)
"She threatened to resign if the policy changed." (warn about a negative action)
"He offered to cover her shifts while she was away." (volunteer to do something)
"She claimed to have five years of experience." (say you have / are something)
"She advised him to update his LinkedIn profile."
"The mentor encouraged her to apply for the leadership programme."
"He warned her not to accept the first offer without negotiating."
"She persuaded the board to delay the decision."
"He reminded her to bring her portfolio to the interview."
"They invited her to present at the conference."
"She insisted that the interview process was unfair."
"He claimed that he had been misled by the job description."
"She explained that the role had changed significantly."
"He admitted that he had no experience in that area."
"She warned that the project was behind schedule."
"He suggested that the team needed more training."

rows.form: ❌ She suggested to take a break.
rows.example: ✅ She suggested taking a break. (suggest + gerund, NOT to-infinitive)
✅ He recommended that I apply. OR He advised me to apply. (recommend cannot take object + infinitive)

rows.form: ❌ She denied to have taken the money.
rows.example: ✅ She denied taking the money. (deny + gerund, NOT infinitive)

rows.form: ❌ He admitted to make a mistake.
rows.example: ✅ He admitted making a mistake. (admit + gerund)

exercises.text: "She ___ (suggest) ___ the salary before accepting the offer."

exercises.instruction: Complete with the correct verb pattern.
exercises.text: "She denied ___ (take) credit for her colleague's work."

opts: He recommended her to apply for the position.
He recommended her applying for the position.
He recommended that she apply for the position.
He recommended to apply for the position.
exercises.correct: He recommended that she apply for the position.
exercises.hint: "Recommend + that + subject + base verb" OR "recommend + gerund" — NOT "recommend + object + to-inf"

exercises.text: "She advised him ___ (not / accept) the first offer without researching the market rate."
"He admitted ___ (not prepare) adequately for the presentation."
"She promised ___ (send) the updated CV before noon."

opts: He warned her don't sign without reading.
He warned her not to sign without reading.
He warned her to not signing without reading.
He warned her for not signing.
exercises.correct: He warned her not to sign without reading.

exercises.instruction: Which reporting verb is followed by a gerund ONLY?
exercises.hint: "Deny" must be followed by a gerund: "deny doing" (NOT "deny to do")

exercises.text: "He threatened ___ (resign) if the team was not given proper resources."
"She insisted ___ reviewing all contracts before signing."
"He apologised ___ (not / reply) to her email sooner."

opts: She offered help with the application.
She offered to help with the application.
She offered helping with the application.
She offered her help to the application.
exercises.correct: She offered to help with the application.

exercises.text: "'You should update your skills,' she said to him." → She advised ___ his skills.

opts: He agreed to start the project immediately.
She suggested working from home on Fridays.
He claimed to have significant experience.
She denied to have made the error.
exercises.correct: She denied to have made the error.
exercises.hint: "Deny + gerund": "denied making the error" (not "denied to have made")

questions.text: "She admitted ___ the deadline." (she said she missed it)
"She denied ___ (take) any credit for the team's success."
"The mentor encouraged her ___ the position even though it was a stretch."
Which sentence uses a reporting verb correctly?
opts: She suggested to take a different approach.
She denied making any errors in the report.
He admitted to make a mistake.
questions.correct: She denied making any errors in the report.
questions.hint: "Deny + gerund" — all other options have errors

questions.text: "He recommended that she apply for the role" is grammatically correct.
"She warned him ___ (not / sign) the contract without legal advice."
"He promised ___ the performance review on time this quarter."
"He insisted ___ having his annual leave approved before starting the project."
"She ___ (threaten) to go to HR if the situation was not resolved."
"She claimed ___ over ten years of relevant experience."
questions.hint: "Claim + to + infinitive" (claim to have / be / do)
